caption: Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, Milan
composition: Glass-vaulted arcade under overcast dawn light · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera stands at the center of the crossing, looking down one arm of the arcade toward the far dome, with the glass-and-iron vault rising overhead and the ornate stone facades lining both sides. The marble floor's great circular mosaic spreads across the foreground, and the shops stand shuttered and dark at 07:07. Overcast dawn light filters grey and even through the glass roof, leaving the gallery empty and hushed.
